HYPOTHESIS: the three non-leader classes are port artifacts with exact source homes — (a) the input reader's free-running 10ms crossterm poll (input.rs POLL_TIMEOUT_MS=10, present since the original port commit f492609c6; the 10ms bounds only the stop-flag check and the escape-guard hold flush), (b)+(c) the run loop's fixed 50ms tick arm (run.rs) and the tokio timer/wake churn it drives — and each has a TS-anchored event/conditional form (TS's stdin is a data-event stream with no idle poll; TS's TUI keeps NO periodic timer at idle: the loader interval runs only while animating, scheduleRender arms only on render requests, the auto-scroll timer only during a held drag), so an edge-driven reader and a work-conditional tick remove ~all of the TUI's idle wakes without deferring any work TS does eagerly and without changing the TUI output bytes.
approach: (1) fold: the lane branched fresh off the tip 4c40e964b (nothing to fold). (2) the tip re-decompose with the census instrument extended with per-thread comm capture (wake_probe.py): 180s attached windows, thread-sum + leader rates, noop sleep-600 control riding every window, keypress latency after. (3) the TS-attached parity leg, the same instrument on the official 0.9.6 release binary run in place (sha 69e5bb9173d0...). (4) THE CUT: (a) READER: the vendored crossterm's event-stream waker machinery enabled + three additive exports (poll_opt(Option<Duration>) = the park-until-input form of poll; waker() -> Option<Waker> = the global event source's wake handle, None when the source failed to open; the Waker type/visibility bumps) — input.rs parks poll_opt(None) whenever the sequence guard holds nothing, keeps POLL_TIMEOUT_MS=10 ONLY while the kitty-probe's answer window is open (enhanced_keys::query_in_flight — the probe's 10ms slices and the reader share crossterm's process-global event-reader lock; a park would starve the #3010 interleave) and when no wake handle exists (a source that failed to open the tty), and the stop flag is observed through Waker::wake at teardown (handoff latency 10ms -> ~0; the flush-to-old-surface and chunk-boundary semantics unchanged); the stop-before-drain ordering added at every teardown choke point that polls crossterm directly (Renderer::finish, the agents-view finish, exit_restore::restore_terminal) so a parked reader can never hold the global lock across a drain or a mount join; (b) TICK: the fixed 50ms arm fires only while a parked autocomplete request or an armed selection auto-scroll exists (predicates snapshotted per iteration; the fresh-sleep-per-iteration timing is unchanged from the base's select shape), and the 2s bash-activity poll moves to its own absolute sleep_until arm (same cadence); (c) TWO LATENT-TIMER DEPENDENCIES the unconditional tick was masking got their own deadline arms: the action toasts' TTL repaint and the Ctrl+C exit-hint expiry (both were tick-driven repaints on an otherwise idle surface; both now arm render_deadline exactly like the hint expiry already did). THE FIX: a pending non-handoff exit now takes the frame arm immediately (render_deadline = now; the frame arm is the one that can wake now), so the exit's tail pass and the loop condition run in the same iteration — strictly sooner than the tick ever delivered it; the force-quit route then passed at the base's exact 4.00s solo and the full exit-route matrix went green. wedge_disclosure.the_finding: THE CUT'S OWN LATENT DEPENDENCY, caught by the gate and root-caused with a full oracle chain: the headless settle gate (which ends every headless run) and its 60s bound both run at the loop top, so a settle waiting out a member needs the loop to wake to re-check - and after the idle-wake cut a fully quiet select parks forever (the quiet tick now arms only on pending work; the ui_rx arm deliberately parks once the plan is done; the frame deadline is spent; the bash poll parks without the capability). The plan's HeadlessDone landing with a pending frame leaves the gate holding 'an unpainted frame' it would clear one iteration later - and that iteration never comes; the bound meant to convert the wait into a named error fires only on an iteration too. THE OLD UNCONDITIONAL TICK WAS THE SETTLE GATE'S CLOCK - the predecessor's identical gate code ran the battery green on the pre-fold tip; the tip batch's event/paint timing made the race reachable in combination with the cut (the four-hypothesis elimination: not the stale venv, not co-scheduling - the quiet-VM solo reproduces, not the lane delta alone, not the tip alone)
